WITH order_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertune,
    COUNT(DISTINCT orderspivot) as order_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  INNER JOIN orders ON orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
type_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertune,
    order_count,
    order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () as share
  FROM order_type_counts
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as overall_avg_share
  FROM type_shares
),
above_avg_types AS (
  SELECT 
    ts.ordertune,
    ts.order_count,
    ts.share,
    oa.overall_avg_share
  FROM type_shares ts
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ts.share > oa.overall_avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(order_count) as sum_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - overall_avg_share) as avg_excess_share
FROM above_avg_types
